text:
marco: Heads up 10am pull: periodic-access-review shows ~375 stale admin entitlements across prod and staging. ~48% lack owner metadata.
auditor-bot: report uploaded: s3://redwood-sec/reports/periodic-access-4321000000.csv :page_with_curl:
rachael: Hmm, that's worrying. Any immediate P0s?
marco: I flagged 7 P0s: 3 service accounts with admin role used by nightly batch jobs, 4 project keys with no owner tag and ambiguous KMS grants.
sam: Can we validate actual usage before touching anything? last time we removed bindings a cron job failed for 2 hours.
marco: Plan suggestion:
- Triage window (48h): assign owners where obvious, create exception tickets for infra-critical items.
- Discovery run: non-destructive permission analysis + invocation-simulate for SAs.
- Controlled removal window (1 week): low-traffic hours, oncall present, rollback scripts ready.
devops-bot: discovery-run CLI:
```
# list impacted principals and simulated effects
./tools/perm_audit --input s3://redwood-sec/reports/periodic-access-4321000000.csv --simulate --out findings.json
```
rachael: For KMS specifics, we should check key ACLs and grants. Suggest this query to dump principals: 
```
# GCP KMS IAM dump
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PR/locations/global/keyRings/KR/cryptoKeys/KEY --format=json
```
sam: Additive idea: run a short-lived honeypot SA removal in a staging project to validate detection and rollback.
marco: Good call. Also we need a strict escalation doc: page infra-oncall -> run emergency_rebind.sh -> notify stakeholders -> open rollback postmortem. Emergency script location: vault://scripts/emergency_rebind_2025.sh (ACL: sec-admins, sres)
devops-bot: Emergency script audit: last used 2025-06-18; logs: vault://audits/rebind/4321000000.log
rachael: Action items:
- @sam: build smoke-test matrix for the 3 nightly jobs (due Tue EOD)
- @rachael: enumerate KMS keys with missing project tags and owners (due Wed)
- @marco: schedule discovery-run and coordinate oncall (start Fri)
sam: I'll coordinate with infra CI owners. Propose 72h public notice before removals.
rachael: If keys are missing tags, propose an infra lambda to auto-create tickets: detect->tag-suggest->owner-assign. Low-risk incremental.
marco: Also, add a metric to the recert dashboard: "ownerless_admin_pct" and a weekly alert if >20%.
sam: Regarding rollback privileges, ensure emergency_rebind.sh requires 2FA and logs to vault. Also rotate the script's vault token after each use.
devops-bot: quick-find results: 7 flagged SAs, 9 keys missing project tag, 2 keys used by cron-SAs (HIGH). CSV attached to the board ticket.
marco: Thanks. I'll update the board with the triage checklist and link to the discovery-run results. Keep updates brief here.
rachael: Update: enumerations in progress, posting CSV to ticket when ready.
sam: Update: CI owners looped in; payments and analytics confirmed testing windows.
marco: Good. Next update in 24h. :heavy_check_mark:
